_comment: Intensity-augmentation sweep. Selection was made on VALIDATION loss only; the test split took no part. Reproduce each row with: python training/train.py --arch bn --intensity <value>
hypothesis: Backward (mean band 6.44) and Slouch (6.15) differ by only ~4.5% in overall level, so a +/-10% intensity augmentation may be erasing the signal that separates them.
outcome_note: The sweep improved validation loss (0.0710 -> 0.0381) but did NOT fix the Backward->Slouch failure on the test set: test accuracy moved 0.8525 -> 0.8361 (Backward recall 1/10 -> 0/10). The difference is one test image and is not statistically meaningful. Reported for transparency: the augmentation setting is not the cause of the Backward failure.
validation_saturation_note: Validation accuracy is 1.0000 for every configuration, so the validation split can no longer discriminate between candidate models. Further tuning would require more recording sessions, not more hyperparameter search.
